activity.extraction: Curated compound labels and raw assay values, with missing/range/inactive/censored labels kept separate.

erratum.note: Corrects source attribution of gamma-Glu-Abu (compound 20) to WO2010/114022A1; no numerical correction in this erratum.

patent_assignment_sensitivity.note: Six hydroxy-acid label/value assignments differ from journal table. Alternative labels are a sensitivity scenario, not independent replicates.

receptor.note: Native SDF extracted earlier from deposited ligand; original CIF supplied for review and receptor preparation.

sensory_boundary.note: 5 ppm EVG in chicken consomme: saltiness change not statistically significant. This is not a receptor activity label.

novelty: All generated combinations are only absent from the extracted series. The hydroxy-acid ester scaffold is explicitly described by the earlier patent, with norvaline included. No new chemical novelty established.
archive_reference: Prior docking outputs dated 2026-10-14; used only if user sets RUN_DOCKING=False. Default runs new jobs.
curation_scope: 103 publisher table rows match 102 unique curated labels; EVG appears twice. 18 additional narrative-only inactive compounds are separate annotations with unspecified assay system, not HEK-293 regression labels.
grouping_rule: Canonical non-stereochemical SMILES of the isolated middle monomer; Ile/allo-Ile and Thr/allo-Thr stay together. 26 constitutional groups replace the earlier 28 name-based groups.
